title: Dice roller
description: A pixel dice roller: choose 1 to 3 dice, a Roll button, show each die's face and the total, and keep a history of the last 5 rolls.

title: Habit tracker
description: A pixel habit tracker: add a habit by name, each habit has 7 day boxes to toggle done, and shows its current streak; habits can be deleted.

title: BMI calculator
description: A pixel BMI calculator: height in cm and weight in kg, a Calculate button, show the BMI to one decimal and its category (underweight, normal, overweight, obese).

title: Stopwatch
description: A pixel stopwatch: Start, Stop, Lap and Reset buttons, a big mm:ss.cs display, and a numbered list of lap times.

title: Tic-tac-toe
description: A pixel tic-tac-toe game for two players: X goes first, show whose turn it is, detect a win or a draw, highlight the winning line and offer a Restart button.

title: Flashcards
description: A pixel flashcard deck of 5 built-in vocabulary cards: click the card to flip between word and meaning, Previous and Next buttons, a 'Got it' button and a known count.

title: Password generator
description: A pixel password generator: a length setting from 8 to 32, toggles for uppercase, numbers and symbols, a Generate button, the password shown in a box and a strength label.

title: Rock paper scissors
description: A pixel rock-paper-scissors game against the computer: three choice buttons, show both choices and the round result, keep the player and computer scores and a Reset button.
